text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that City Council remove directors from the Fairbank Village and Uptown Yonge Business Improvement Area (BIA) Boards of Management.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council remove the following directors from the following Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below: Fairbank Village: Capotorto, Domenic Uptown Yonge: Mazzaferro, Marco Silva, Jaclyn
